title: Photocatalytic reduction of hexavalent chromium by 2D Fe-MOF: mechanistic insights, continuous-flow applications, and ecological safety validation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00739A, Communication
Zheng-Xing Liu, Hong-Yu Chu, Xiao-Hong Yi, Ze-Ming Huang, Fei Wang, Ya Gao, Xing-Yuan Liu, Ke-Xin Li, Chong-Chen Wang
An improved solvothermal-synthesized 2D Fe-MOF (S-BUC-21(Fe)) achieves rapid photocatalytic reduction of Cr(VI) to Cr(III) within 6 min using tartaric acid under UV light and sunlight.
